reason: The plugin is a DeepSeek Harness extension focused on orchestrating runtime context and tool services by workspace, including workspace-scoped Cordis composition loading, live config-driven reload, and MCP server/process management with agent-preset integration. User-facing behavior is primarily operational/runtime management for agents and external tools rather than editor UI, content creation, or visualization features.

summaries.zh: 本插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按工作区隔离的运行时管理：按 workspace 建立独立 Cordis scope，监听 `.dsh/cordis.yml` 进行热重载，并管理 MCP 服务器与 Agent 预设绑定。
summaries.en: This plugin adds workspace-scoped runtime orchestration to DeepSeek Harness by creating per-workspace Cordis scopes, reloading on workspace config changes, and managing MCP server lifecycles with agent preset binding.

capabilities: Per-workspace Cordis scope acquisition and shared lease-based ownership
Loads workspace-scoped composition from .dsh/cordis.yml when trusted
Monitors workspace config file changes and performs scoped hot reload
Wraps agent create/resume flow to bind agents to workspace-local preset generations
Manages MCP client processes and tool registrations with namespace masking per workspace
Spawns/controls subprocess-based MCP transport and tracks connection lifecycle
